trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: The dough was rising for hours when I came.
trap.right: The dough had been rising for hours when I came.
trap.why: O português usa o imperfeito para tudo. Duração anterior a outro fato passado pede had been + -ing.

mcq.q: The dough **___** for hours when I came.
Contraste: the dough **___** rise, so I waited.

fix.wrong: I had been wait for hours.
fix.right: I had been waiting for hours.

rewrite.answer: It had been rising for hours.
